name: How To Treat Your Enemies
overview: Scripture instructs believers to respond to enemies with restraint and righteousness rather than rejoicing in their downfall or seeking vengeance. Proverbs warns against delighting when an enemy stumbles and highlights the dishonor of the righteous succumbing to the wicked. Jesus teaches a departure from the law of retaliation, urging His followers to avoid violence and trust in God's justice, as seen in His command to put away the sword. Ultimately, trusting in God as a refuge and strength encourages believers to treat enemies with grace and self-control, reflecting the joy and gladness of serving the Lord.
